arguments.query: select b.booking_id,b.status,b.request_id,b.flight_id,b.amount_cents,b.client_reference,(select group_concat(charge_id||":"||idempotency_key) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id) ch from bookings b
select o.event_id,o.status,o.attempts,length(o.payload) l,b.status bs,b.flight_id from outbox o left join bookings b on b.booking_id=o.booking_id where o.status="pending"
select b.booking_id,b.status,b.flight_id,b.amount_cents,c.charge_id,c.idempotency_key,c.status cs from bookings b left join charges c on c.booking_id=b.booking_id where b.status="pending"
select sql from sqlite_master where name in ("charges","holds","bookings")

select b.booking_id bid,b.flight_id f,b.amount_cents a,c.charge_id,c.idempotency_key k,c.amount_cents ca,c.state,(select count(*) from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) h from bookings b left join charges c on c.booking_id=b.booking_id where b.status="pending"
select o.event_id,o.status,o.attempts,o.payload from outbox o where o.status!="delivered" union all select booking_id,status,0,flight_id from bookings where status!="confirmed"
select service,status,path,message,count(*) n,max(duration_ms) d from (select * from request_logs order by rowid desc limit 120) where status>=400 group by 1,2,3,4
select service,status,message,count(*) n from (select * from request_logs order by rowid desc limit 40) where status>=400 group by 1,2,3

select "nohold" k,count(*) n from bookings b where status="confirmed" and not exists(select 1 from holds h where h.booking_id=b.booking_id) union all select "charges!=1",count(*) from bookings b where status="confirmed" and (select count(*) from charges c where c.booking_id=b.booking_id and state="captured")!=1 union all select "orphancharge",count(*) from charges c where not exists(select 1 from bookings b where b.booking_id=c.booking_id) union all select "nocheckin",count(*) from bookings b where status="confirmed" and not exists(select 1 from checkins k where k.booking_id=b.booking_id) union all select "pend",count(*) from bookings where status="pending" union all select "capacity",sum(capacity) from flights union all select "holds",count(*) from holds union all select "charge_amt_mismatch",count(*) from charges c join bookings b using(booking_id) where c.amount_cents!=b.amount_cents
select rowid,service,path,status,substr(message,1,40) m from request_logs where service in ("booking","pricing") order by rowid desc limit 24
select id,service,path,status,substr(message,1,50) m from request_logs where id>700 and status>=400 and message not like "%sold out%" and message not like "%flight sold%" order by id desc limit 20
select f.*,(select count(*) from holds h where h.flight_id=f.flight_id) h,(select count(*) from bookings b where b.flight_id=f.flight_id and status="confirmed") c from flights f
select * from customer_events order by rowid desc limit 8
select booking_id,request_id,status from bookings where request_id in (select request_id from customer_events)
